newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino will not sell gene-products under own brand.
newsitem.headline: Casino will not sell gene-products under own brand.

text.p: French retailer Casino said on Wednesday that it will not sell products containing genetically-modified materials under its own Casino and Casino Palmares brands.
"The Casino group has decided to prevent its suppliers from partly or totally including genetically-modified organisms in products carrying the Casino or Casino Palmares brand," the statement said.
Casino stores also sell products from other groups. A Casino spokeswoman said it was up to these companies to define their position towards genetically-modified organisms.
She added the decision meant that Casino would not sell Casino and Casino Palmares products containing genetically-modified soybean or maize.
In the statement Casino said the decision was aimed at providing customers with "maximum food safety conditions".
Casino controls 110 hypermarkets, 467 supermarkets and 2,257 smaller-sized stores.
